subject: CAIQ: KMS/HSM runbook & rotation artifacts for AureliaHealth
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aureliahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ evidence: KMS/HSM runbook and rotation artifacts

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of AureliaHealth's CAIQ review we need a compact deliverable that covers:

- KMS key lifecycle (generation, rotation, revocation, destruction)
- HSM operator matrix and shift logs (or an extract)
- Evidence of encryption-in-transit and at-rest controls and the current TLS / cipher baseline
- Runbook for emergency key rotation and cross-region fallback

Can you provide a small package (PDF + CSV) that the auditor can consume? We have a 5/6 deadline for our internal split review. If there are any items that will be redacted, please flag them and provide a brief explanation.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Lena
Lena Ortiz
InfoSec Manager, AureliaHealth
lena.ortiz@aureliahealth.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence: KMS/HSM runbook and rotation artifacts

Lena — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a compact CAIQ-friendly packet.

Quick notes / questions so we deliver exactly what you need:

- KMS lifecycle: we'll include the runbook PDF that documents creation, automated rotation schedules (including thresholds), and operator steps for emergency rotation. That will reference our BYOK and tenant-wrapping flows where applicable. Does the auditor need itemized rotation timestamps or a representative recent sample will suffice?
- HSM operator matrix: we can provide an operator matrix CSV and a redacted shift-log extract. Please confirm whether the auditor requires operator emails or just role-level identifiers.
- TLS & in-transit: we'll include the current cipher baseline and a short TLS config extract from our ingress layer. Note that some load balancer configs contain env-specific hostnames we'll redact.
- Delivery format: PDF (runbook), CSV (operator matrix + shift-sample), DOCX (short assertion) — acceptable?

Action: Marissa, can you assemble the runbook + CSV extracts and mark any items that must be redacted for PII? Ben, can you confirm if we should include a HubSpot ticket link for procurement traceability in the package?

We'll aim to deliver an initial package by EOD 5/3 with final revised by 5/4.

Thanks,

Rachel Kim
Senior Security Manager
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
From: Tom Becker <tom.becker@aureliahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence: KMS/HSM runbook and rotation artifacts

Rachel — quick clarifications from our auditor:

- Representative rotation timestamps are fine (3 latest rotations per environment).
- Operator matrix should include employee ID and role (emails optional). If you need to redact PII, include role + anonymized id (e.g., OP-23) and provide a short mapping in a secured channel.
- For TLS baseline, they asked for the cipher suite list and FIPS mode status where applicable.

We appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom
Tom Becker
Security Controls, AureliaHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aureliahealth.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence: KMS/HSM runbook and rotation artifacts

Hi Lena / Tom — delivering the initial packet as requested. Attached:

- kms-rotation-runbook-v1.3.pdf (runbook: lifecycle, emergency rotation steps, BYOK notes)
- hsm-operator-matrix-2027.csv (role-level matrix + anonymized operator ids)
- hsm-shiftlog-sample.txt (redacted shift log excerpt; PII removed)
- soc2-encryption-assertion-2027.docx (short attestation for SOC2 use)

Notes:
- Rotation timestamps: included 3 most recent rotations per region (UTC timestamps) in the runbook appendix.
- Cipher baseline: included as an annex in the runbook (TLS 1.2/1.3 allowed ciphers; FIPS mode noted where deployed).
- Redactions: operator emails have been anonymized; if your auditor requires full mapping we can provide via an SFTP link under an NDA or a signed PA.

Next steps: Ben will follow up on procurement traceability and provide the HubSpot ticket link; Rachel will schedule a short call tomorrow if you want to walk through anything in the packet.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: kms-rotation-runbook-v1.3.pdf (PDF), hsm-operator-matrix-2027.csv (CSV), hsm-shiftlog-sample.txt (TXT), soc2-encryption-assertion-2027.docx (DOCX)
